question.en: What is the main problem today?

answer.zh-CN: 她活动后气短，后来咳粉红色痰，不能平卧。
answer.en: She became breathless on exertion, then coughed pink sputum and could not lie flat.

answer.zh-CN: 气短有 4 个月，入院前 1 天明显加重。
answer.en: Breathlessness lasted four months and worsened a day before admission.

question.zh-CN: 这段时间病情怎样变化？
question.en: How has the problem changed over time?

answer.zh-CN: 送医途中失去意识，抢救后恢复心跳和意识。
answer.en: She lost consciousness during transport and regained circulation and awareness after resuscitation.

answer.zh-CN: 活动后心慌、胸闷，偶尔胸痛，休息可好转。
answer.en: Exertion caused palpitations and tightness, sometimes pain, relieved by rest.

finding.en: A grade 4/6 aortic systolic murmur radiated to the neck.

text.zh-CN: 出现室速、室颤，血压测不出，大动脉搏动消失；胸外按压、通气及 3 次除颤后恢复窦律和意识。
text.en: VT/VF with unmeasurable BP and absent central pulse; compressions, ventilation and three shocks preceded restored sinus rhythm and awareness.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: TC 18.32 mmol/L、LDL-C 15.36 mmol/L、TG 1.04 mmol/L。
text.en: TC 18.32 mmol/L, LDL-C 15.36 mmol/L and TG 1.04 mmol/L.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 主动脉瓣重度狭窄伴少中量返流，多处钙化，二尖瓣中度返流，左室壁运动异常和功能减低；CT 同样提示重度主动脉瓣狭窄。
text.en: Severe aortic stenosis with mild-to-moderate regurgitation, extensive calcification, moderate mitral regurgitation, abnormal LV wall motion and reduced function; CT also showed severe aortic stenosis.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 颈动脉、锁骨下动脉广泛斑块及多处狭窄。
text.en: Extensive carotid/subclavian plaques with multiple stenoses.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 支持治疗和联合降脂后出院 LDL-C 13.25 mmol/L；1 个月后 LDL-C 13.36 mmol/L，未再发室颤。未记载 TAVR 完成情况。
text.en: Following supportive care and combination lipid treatment, discharge LDL-C was 13.25 mmol/L and at one month 13.36 mmol/L, without recurrent VF. Completion of TAVR was not documented.

text.zh-CN: 严重遗传性高胆固醇血症伴早发动脉粥样硬化和瓣膜病
text.en: Severe inherited hypercholesterolaemia with premature atherosclerotic and valve disease

feedback.zh-CN: 幼年起病、父母受累及极高 LDL-C 一致。
feedback.en: Childhood onset, affected parents and extreme LDL-C are concordant.

text.zh-CN: 年龄年轻即可排除器质性心脏病
text.en: Youth excludes structural heart disease

feedback.zh-CN: 影像已经显示重度病变。

text.zh-CN: 只由一次情绪激动引起
text.en: A single emotional episode explains everything

feedback.zh-CN: 不能解释长期表型和血脂。
feedback.en: That does not explain the longstanding phenotype and lipids.

prompt.zh-CN: 复苏后需要怎样的专科路径？
prompt.en: What specialist pathway is needed after resuscitation?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 心脏与血脂团队并行评估瓣膜、冠脉和强化降脂选择
text.en: Cardiac and lipid teams assess valves, coronaries and intensive lipid-lowering options

feedback.zh-CN: 不能只处理一次心律失常而忽略基础病。
feedback.en: Treating the rhythm alone misses the underlying disease.

text.zh-CN: 既往基因治疗意味着无需继续降脂
text.en: Previous gene therapy means no further lipid care

text.zh-CN: 一个月无室颤即可停止随访
text.en: Stop follow-up after a month without VF

feedback.zh-CN: 短随访不能证明风险消失。
feedback.en: Short follow-up does not show risk elimination.

feedback.en: Follow-up LDL-C remained high and cure is not established.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 严重 HoFH 伴广泛动脉及瓣膜病，复苏后的短期稳定不代表风险解除。
conclusion.en: Severe HoFH with widespread arterial and valve disease; short-term stability after resuscitation does not remove future risk.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 幼年表型与家族史支持遗传性病因。
keyReasoning.en: Childhood phenotype and family history support inherited disease.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: EAS 2023 强调专科综合降脂，不能沿用“无有效治疗”的旧结论。
keyReasoning.en: EAS 2023 supports specialist combination lipid care, rather than the historical claim of no effective treatment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 将计划、实施和结局分别记录。
keyReasoning.en: Separate planned care, completed intervention and outcome.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
